definitions: On strike, taking part in industrial action.
present participle and gerund of strike

blocks.text: Strike is a surname. Notable people with the surname include:

items: Alice Strike (1896–2004), last surviving female Canadian military World War I veteran
Anne Wafula Strike, British wheelchair racer
Cormoran Strike, a fictional detective in the novels of 'Robert Galbraith'
Fred Strike (1880–1967), Canadian ice hockey player
Sylvaine Strike, South African actress, writer and theatre director

blocks.text: Hobart Huson, also known as Strike, is the founder and site designer of online forum The Hive and author of several popular books such as Total Synthesis I and II, and Sources, in which he details methods of synthesizing a variety of amphetamines, obtaining equipment and chemicals, and avoiding prosecution for said activity. From his books, it is clear that MDMA was the drug he found to be most compelling : in the book, he describes it as "the most benign drug [I have] ever encountered."
